data.body_html:
Thinking about a marbella boat rental no license what you need to know? You’re in the right place. In 2026, chartering a boat on the Costa del Sol without a licence is simpler than ever. Every rental includes a professional skipper, so you don’t need any paperwork—just turn up and enjoy the Mediterranean. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on our Tier A boats, and all charters include fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and tax. This guide covers the legal side, the boats available, what’s included, and how to book.

Do You Need a Licence to Rent a Boat in Marbella?

No. Spanish regulations require a licence to drive a boat yourself, but with our service, you’re not driving. Every charter includes a licensed skipper who handles all navigation, mooring, and safety. You and your guests can relax, swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the coast. This applies to every boat in our fleet, from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 to the 29m Ferretti 94.

How Much Does a No-Licence Boat Rental Cost in Marbella?

Our pricing is transparent. For the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers), the rate is €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 passengers) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter and includes a free jet ski. For all other boats—like the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, or Lagoon 380—pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. No hidden fees, no surprises.

What’s Included in Every Charter?

Every rental includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, full insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% tax). You don’t need to bring anything except sunscreen and a towel. The skipper will take you to the best spots along the Marbella coastline, from the Golden Mile to Cabopino.

Which Boats Can You Charter Without a Licence?

All of them. Here’s our full fleet, all departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h

  • Pershing 46 – 14m, 10 pax
  • Red Tide – 11m, 6 pax
  • Speedboat – 7m, 6 pax
  • Maiora 26m – 26m, 12 pax

For full details on our fleet, visit our homepage.

Where Can You Go on a No-Licence Charter?

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise east toward Marbella’s town beaches and the dunes of Cabopino, or west to Estepona and Sotogrande. Popular stops include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coves near Río Verde. Your skipper knows the best anchorages for swimming, snorkelling, and lunch at a beachfront chiringuito.

How to Book a No-Licence Boat Rental in Marbella

Booking is easy. Simply send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We’ll confirm availability and send you a quote. Payment is secure, and the skipper will meet you at the marina. For more tips on planning your trip, read our complete guide.
